items.text: Hello operators!

Embark on a new chapter in Port Wake's journey with the first DLC in the New Horizons Expansion Pack, as you work one step closer towards achieving international port status! As part of the Deep Waters update, master the powerful new Magnet Gripper Attachment and put your operational skills to the test with 12 new jobs, a new campaign mission, and a brand-new milestone.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45740004/d5d4c98927d85c04a67d541be4d05d9bba61e5ab.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45740004/cf0827379a063929b424e16bac96a861cca4c17b.png"]Introducing the all-new Magnet Gripper attachment, exclusive to the "Deep Waters" DLC! This heavy-duty tool uses electromagnetic power to lift and move various metal objects across a variety of new jobs and missions. It's a versatile piece of kit that can be attached to the MHC Crane, Reach Stacker, STS Crane, RMG Crane, and Straddle Carrier.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45740004/5154f577aeb8cad16fa1150b585ffe333214d5d3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45740004/e5814aabbdf19b12b461d8f615d537edc66624a7.png"]Test your skills with 12 brand-new jobs and a new mission called "Release"! This update brings new challenges that will take you all around Port Wake. You'll be responsible for tasks such as cleaning up roadside accidents, maintaining the harbour, and recovering items from the sea using the brand-new Magnet Gripper attachment; moving Port Wake one step closer to achieving international port status.
Please note: To access the new exclusive DLC content, Press New Game, select the DLC1 Campaign, and then transfer your progress from your completed campaign or begin with the default preset.

Hello operators,
Today's update brings several popular community-requested features to Docked, such as support for Logitech's Heavy Equipment Bundle, joystick support, and Free Play Mode (v1)!

Introducing v1 of Free Play Mode! The plan for this much-requested mode is to develop it in stages so we can collect feedback and make adjustments with each iteration we release. This new gamemode provides a dedicated environment for operators looking to fulfill large-scale orders, allowing them to manage cargo without the constraints of mission objectives or time pressure. Free Play is designed for operators to refine their skills, explore the port at their own pace, and engage with the various machinery in a sandbox setting.

notes.title: Key elements of Free Play Mode (v1)

items.text: Accessible from the start, no unlock required.
Operators have access to a new handheld tablet to manage and monitor the cargo plan in real time. No more loading in and out of menus!
Operators fulfill the cargo plan by loading and unloading containers between the ship, the yard, and the train.
Operators have access to the STS Crane, Reach Stacker, Straddle Carrier, Terminal Tractor, and RTG Crane.
Operators can save mid-way through a mission to continue their work from where they left off.
Operators can change time and weather through the new handheld tablet.
Operators can focus strictly on machinery operations and ignore economic constraints.
Operators can instantly generate new cargo plans upon completion to keep the yard running indefinitely.
We look forward to reading your feedback as we continue to improve and expand Free Play Mode.
Added Free Play Mode (v1)

items.text: Hello operators,
Today's update introduces a new quality-of-life feature and several bug fixes. We are also excited to give you a first look at our upcoming freeplay mode.

First order of business: we heard your feedback regarding minigames, and while we believe they add an interesting element to Docked, we also want to ensure that everyone can enjoy the game in their own way. As such, minigames are now optional. This means players can now choose to skip minigames or complete them to earn additional rewards.

Next up, freeplay mode. We will be introducing it in stages, with V1 arriving in about a month. This should allow all of you to provide early feedback and help us make adjustments as we continue to implement the new mode. We will continue to improve freeplay mode through multiple iterations based on feedback from Steam Discussions and the subreddit.

notes.title: What will be in V1 of freeplay mode?

items.text: Freeplay mode will be available right from the start, with no need to complete the campaign to unlock it. In this mode, players will receive a cargo plan that serves as a mission hub, allowing them to seamlessly accept orders without leaving the port. What does this mean for gameplay?
Missions will be longer than those in the campaign
Missions will involve loading and unloading containers between the ship and the yard.
Players can choose any of the machinery to use for these tasks.
Players can save mid-way through a mission to be able to continue their work from where they left off.
We are planning more for future versions, including AI workers for the port who will assist in completing bigger orders.
As always, we love hearing from you about all things Docked, so keep it coming!
Minigames are now optional! Operators who choose to complete these tasks will now receive additional performance rewards.
Enhanced the capture logic for oversize cargo to improve handling and alignment accuracy during lifts.

Hello operators!

We have our first in a series of updates based specifically on the feedback you have left for us since launch. As we mentioned in our last update post, we are simultaneously working on the contents of the New Horizons pack and the implementation of new features based on what you would like to see.
Today's update introduces the new "open port" feature, along with bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45740004/0af551f6ff0b744dfc88ab2a9363880466daba4f.jpg"]
That's right. We've cleared the schedule to allow you to stay on the clock and replay Milestone 7 jobs as many times as you'd like.
(Keep in mind that we're not paying you overtime rates. YOU WANTED THIS.)
Once you've fully restored Port Wake back to its former glory, a new job will appear for you on the job board: Open Port.
This is your chance to wander Port Wake and take a second to appreciate all the hard work you've put in. No tasks, no quotas, and zero pressure. Just you, the machinery, and the yard.
You'll now be able to find the "All Jobs" option in the Main Menu. This allows you to pick up extra shifts and rerun any jobs from the main campaign as many times as you want.
Every job is available in both Normal and Hard difficulties, ensuring that you can go back for any tasks you may have missed during your last shift.
Jobs will become available to this menu automatically once you've completed their corresponding milestone in Port Wake.
Smoothed out CPU spikes during shader compilation to keep the hardware from stuttering when the yard gets busy
Added additional operational hints for the Reach Stacker during the “Dangerous Cargo” job to assist with handling
Updated the Codex so all translated pages display the correct language for international crews
Cleaned up a crash in the "Supply Delivery" job that occurred when handling burning containers
Tightened the mount screws on the STS crane's spreader camera to eliminate violent shaking during operation
Recalibrated container spawn points and unload zones in the "Unloading a Ship" job so they actually line up with the manifest
Corrected the manifest for "Warehouse Restoration" to reflect the actual number of containers required for the job
Resolved an issue where surface reflections would flicker when viewed from specific angles across the docks
(Steam) Fixed a synchronization error that prevented the “Docked” achievement from being logged as completed

And that's not all! The team is already working on implementing the initial version of Freeplay mode for Docked. Unlike the main campaign, this mode will be available immediately with no job requirements or economic constraints. It's just you, the machinery, and the manifest.
You can expect Freeplay mode and more soon in Docked. So don't go wandering off.
-Team Docked

items.text: Hey gang!

We have pushed a small patch for the demo to address several performance issues that you (yes, you!) reported via the in-game survey. Thank you to everyone who took the time to submit feedback to the team.
Fixed an issue that could cause stuttering without a noticeable FPS drop.
Fixed an issue where enabling V-sync would unnecessarily lower the game’s FPS.
Fixed an issue where enabling V-Sync could cause instability.
Added ShaderWarmup; this should help with the performance issues caused by shader compilation.
Improved visual smoothness when rotating the camera.

We are closely investigating performance issues on high-end hardware. If you are rocking a modern GPU and have encountered performance issues while playing Docked, we would appreciate it if you could take a moment to complete the feedback survey - even if you had previously - to help us make Docked run the smoothest it can.
The Docked Team
